summary: The media session and audio-focus code now records richer telemetry for the Audio Session API and audio-arbitration events, and browser tests were added to validate those probes. Behavior around short interruptions (like transient audio interruptions) was improved so the session keeps its state across the suspension it causes, which helps audio apps resume smoothly after brief interruptions. **More consistent handling of audio interruptions** makes media playback and background audio behavior feel less jumpy to users.
